testName: Outbound Message Delivery & SOAP Notification Queue Failure Monitoring
steps:
1. Open Opportunities tab and advance Stage to "Closed Won"
2. Verify Workflow / Flow Outbound Message action triggers
3. Open Setup > Monitoring > Outbound Messages
4. Verify Outbound Message queue shows message addressed to "https://erp.example.com/soap/orders"
5. Verify external endpoint returns standard XML `<Ack>true</Ack>`
6. Verify message is successfully flushed from queue without retry failure attempts
7. Verify zero messages queued in "Failed Deliveries"
